architectures.JOINT: authoritative Physics-GRU(64), H8 trajectory head, feasibility head

calibration.primary: raw ensemble mean of per-seed sigmoid logits

continuous_collection.rounding: none; controller accepts native float commands
continuous_collection.sampling: one independent uniform draw per equal-width task-support stratum

dev.touch: once after all six checkpoints complete

objective.feasibility: BCEWithLogits on every individual real branch outcome

probe_secondary_rule.competitive: absolute frontier-MAE difference <0.05N and under-force equal
probe_secondary_rule.estimation_limited: GT passes but Probe is materially worse than No-Probe and errors are GT-correct/Probe-wrong
probe_secondary_rule.evidence_limited: insufficient valid contexts or legitimate matched pairs
probe_secondary_rule.supported: Probe under-force non-worse and frontier MAE improves >=0.05N with probability MAE or excess-force improvement

single_scientific_goal: same-data Feasibility-only versus Joint under direct continuous full-task feasibility supervision
strict_preprobe_interface: authoritative reconstructed last P4-B hold before probe_out; no post-probe state

training.normalization: same TRAIN-only input normalization for both models; Joint output normalization from corrected-valid new branches
